blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Several foreign leaders in the Philippines for the three-day 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit took time to visit the Manila Cathedral, considered the “mother and head of the churches” in the country. In a series of posts, the Manila Cathedral’s Facebook page on Saturday shared photos of Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, Canadian Prime Minister Mark Joseph Carney and Cyprus’ Minister of Transport, Communications and Works Evie Tsolaki, who each joined a guided tour of the basilica.
